question:
A factory plans to produce three types of products, I, II, and III, which require processing on devices A, B, and C, respectively. The data is shown in Table 2-3.
Table 2-3
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline Device Code & I & II & III & Monthly Device Capacity \\
\hline A & 8 & 2 & 10 & 300 \\
\hline B & 10 & 5 & 8 & 400 \\
\hline C & 2 & 13 & 10 & 420 \\
\hline Unit Product Profit (in thousands) & 3 & 2 & 2.9 & \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
How can the factory fully utilize the capacity of the devices to maximize profit?

        "B": {"I": 10, "II": 5, "III": 8},
        "C": {"I": 2, "II": 13, "III": 10},
    },
    # monthly device capacity
    "capacity": {"A": 300, "B": 400, "C": 420},
    # unit product profit (thousands)
    "profit": {"I": 3, "II": 2, "III": 2.9},
}

#          domain: NonNegativeReals, bounds (0, None)

#

#   1) Device A capacity: 8*x_I + 2*x_II + 10*x_III <= 300
#   2) Device B capacity: 10*x_I + 5*x_II + 8*x_III <= 400
#   3) Device C capacity: 2*x_I + 13*x_II + 10*x_III <= 420
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DATA = {
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    "devices": ["A", "B", "C"],
    "profits": {"I": 3.0, "II": 2.0, "III": 2.9},
    "usage": {
        "A": {"I": 8, "II": 2, "III": 10},
        "B": {"I": 10, "II": 5, "III": 8},

    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets ------------------------------------------------------------------
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])  # products
    model.R = pyo.Set(initialize=d["devices"])   # devices / resources

    # Variables -------------------------------------------------------------
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))

    # Parameters ------------------------------------------------------------
    model.profit = pyo.Param(model.P, initialize=dict(d["profits"]), within=pyo.Reals)
    model.cap = pyo.Param(model.R, initialize=dict(d["cap"]), within=pyo.Reals)

    def usage_init(m, r, p):
        return d["usage"][r][p]
    model.usage = pyo.Param(model.R, model.P, rule=usage_init, within=pyo.Reals)

    # Objective -------------------------------------------------------------
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(m.profit[p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Constraints -----------------------------------------------------------
    def cap_rule(m, r):
        return sum(m.usage[r, p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P) <= m.cap[r]
    model.cap_con = pyo.Constraint(model.R, rule=cap_rule)

    return model
